message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "longitudinal_imaging_synthesis", "description": "When a clinical question implies temporal progression, comparison, or change over time involving multiple images, do not rely on single-image analysis tools in isolation.", "applicable_conditions": "The user query contains keywords indicating chronology (e.g., 'progression', 'change', 'improvement', 'worsening', 'compared to') or explicitly references multiple figures/timepoints, but the available tools only provide static, single-image interpretations.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the query requires assessing progression or comparing multiple timepoints: (1) Explicitly identify all referenced images/timepoints; (2) Call the image analysis tool for EACH relevant image individually to extract static findings; (3) Manually synthesize these independent outputs to identify trends (e.g., new opacities, resolving effusions) rather than relying on a single snapshot; (4) Cross-reference the synthesized temporal trend with clinical history (e.g., exertion, trauma) before selecting the final diagnosis. Do not infer longitudinal changes from a single image report."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
